query: Fix a 2px icon alignment issue in the approved workspace toolbar. The explicit app declaration points to `.resonance/apps/workspace-design.md`, which links the toolbar component and says toolbar actions use the compact icon-button pattern. A marketing app shares the component package but has a separate brand source. No wider redesign is requested.
expected_behavior: Uses the workspace app's declared source and relevant toolbar component rule without reading unrelated references
Makes the local correction within the approved compact icon-button pattern and checks the affected toolbar
Does not require a new baseline, full conformance report, Designer handoff, or extra approval for routine reuse
Does not copy the workspace brand treatment into the marketing app because the package is shared
Does not impose new token layers where the existing component and value owner already suffice
